verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Unity can run the Editor and Player from the command line and the Player in a headless mode, and that its CLI and Build Automation target CI builds. Nothing in the pack documents a test framework, a test runner, or running unit or integration tests in CI against the engine. Headless launch and CI builds are adjacent capabilities that do not by themselves deliver headless test execution.

support.subject: As a game developer, tests run headlessly — unit and integration tests of game code execute in CI against the real engine
